thread:
courtney (PM): Quick sync: Big customer wants a pricing path that separates bursty generation traffic from steady embeddings. Their ask: per-route add-on + contract-level hard ceilings + observable cost breakdown. Need decision on what we commit for pilot.

ryan (Eng): Implementation options: route tags + metering (fast), or quota enforcement at gateway (safer for hard ceilings). Hard ceilings need a durable counter and fast-path check; calendar-window semantics matter (daily vs monthly).

mika (Sales): Customer will only pilot if we can show billing visibility and soft blocking. GA must include hard ceilings in contract. They also want an emergency override for ops.

anjali (Legal): For GA hard ceilings we need precise trigger semantics and remediation terms. For pilot we should use "AS-IS beta" language and avoid SLA commits. Also require audit trail for any overrides.

beau (Solutions): Console must show per-route cost, projected depletion, and a simple admin override with two-step confirmation. Suggest we show both hourly and monthly burn estimates in the estimator.

infra-bot: feature-flag "route-cost-and-ceilings-v1" created in staging.

ryan (Eng): Estimate: route tagging + billing UI + soft alerts = 1 sprint. Hard ceilings + durable quota enforcement + override flow = 3 sprints. Need to decide pilot scope today.

courtney (PM): Proposal: Ship pilot with tagging, billing UI, and soft alerts + webhook. Reserve hard ceilings as GA feature. Pilot launch criteria: visible per-route billing, soft alerts working, pilot agreement signed.

mika (Sales): OK. I'll tell customer pilot will include soft-block demo and that GA hard ceilings are planned. They want NDA and a demo slot next week.

anjali (Legal): I'll prepare pilot addendum: beta terms, no SLA, override audit requirement. For GA I'll draft hard-ceiling clause template.

beau (Solutions): I'll make a Console mock for pilot showing projected monthly burn and a soft-alert webhook flow.

ryan (Eng): Action items: I'll spin up RFC for tagging + soft alert infra. We need tests showing soft-alert webhook firing under load.

courtney (PM): Great. Actions: Ryan -> RFC and tickets; Beau -> Console mock; Anjali -> pilot addendum; Mika -> secure NDA/demo. Sync Fri 9am. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
